meta.description: Mock operational data for V6M Desk, the V6M Resort internal tool. All guests, staff, contact details, references and events are fictional.
rules: A unit holds one booking per night; exclusive events that are reserved, paid or done close the resort for the day.
Each pool session caps at 120 guests (placeholder until the owner confirms).
Rooms and cottages add per-head overnight entrance; the Airbnb villa does not.
A booking stays on hold until at least 50% of the total is paid; checked-out bookings have zero balance.
Downpayment: 50% of the total for every booking, rounded up to the peso; Airbnb is paid in full. Guests on a booking link pay it by GCash QR.
Booking links are single use: a staff member sends one, the guest fills it in, and the booking lands on the calendar.
Rates come from public listings; promo PR-BTS and all event packages are invented for testing.
V6M Desk signs in with an email and password. Demo passwords sit in this file in plain text because it is a mock; a real build would never store them this way.
New accounts are invite only: the owner creates the account, the invite code is used once, and the person sets their own password.
Owners and managers can give a manual discount (amount or percent). Managers must write a note saying why; owners may skip it. The 50% downpayment follows the discounted total.

savedReplies.title: Rates
savedReplies.body:
Hola! Thanks for reaching V6M Resort.

Day tour (8 AM–4 PM): ₱150 adults, ₱100 kids
Overnight (6 PM–6 AM): ₱200 adults, ₱150 kids
Cottages: A ₱2,000 · B ₱1,500 · C ₱1,000
Rooms (3 PM–12 NN): Suite ₱2,500 · Deluxe ₱2,200, plus entrance

So, when's your next vacay?

savedReplies.title: Pets
savedReplies.body: Yes, we're pet-friendly! Dogs and cats are welcome as long as they wear diapers or stay in cages.

savedReplies.title: Directions
savedReplies.body: We're at Purok 3, Brgy. Munting Pulo, Lipa City, Batangas, about 10 minutes from SM Lipa. Message us when you're near and we'll guide you.

savedReplies.title: Down payment
savedReplies.body: To lock in your date, send a 50% down payment via GCash or bank transfer and share the screenshot here. We'll confirm right away.

savedReplies.title: Events
savedReplies.body: Congrats in advance! We'd love to host. Share your date, headcount and type of event, and we'll send packages and schedule an ocular visit.
